info.title: API.SH: ESPN
info.description: The ESPN API from API.SH: public ESPN data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A league's draft (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB ...): every pick with round, pick number, overall number, trade note, the team, and the player (position, height, weight, school, ESPN prospect rank and grade, headshot, link), plus each team's record and positions of need. Filter by round or team.

get.description:
ESPN fantasy rankings for football, basketball, baseball or hockey: rank, player, position, pro team (with bye week), injury status, auction value, percent owned and started, average draft position, projected and actual season points, last season's points, positional rank, season outlook and, with `week`, the weekly expert ranks. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/espn-fantasy-rankings

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: nfl (default), nba, mlb or nhl.

parameters.name: rank_type
parameters.description: nfl: PPR (default), STANDARD, SUPERFLEX; other leagues: STANDARD.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Only one position: nfl QB, RB, WR, TE, K, D/ST, FLEX; nba PG, SG, SF, PF, C, G, F; mlb C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, OF, SP, RP; nhl C, LW, RW, D, G.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season year (default: the current one).

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Scoring period for the weekly expert ranks.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Players per page (default 25, max 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Players to skip (default 0).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Everything ESPN has for one game: header (teams, score, status, venue), game info (venue, attendance, officials, weather), box score (team statistics and every player's stats by category), leaders, plays (play-by-play with clock, score, coordinates and participants) or drives (football), scoring plays, win probability by play, odds and against-the-spread, injuries, rosters/line-ups (soccer, baseball), key events and commentary (soccer), at-bats (baseball), season series, last five games, standings, related news and the recap headline. Use `sections` to return only some parts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/espn-game

parameters.description: Comma-separated extras: `statistics` (season team statistics), `depth_chart` (positions and players in depth order, where the league publishes one), `coaches` (coaching staff with years of experience), `injuries` (the team's injury report), `leaders` (team leaders per statistical category for `season`/`seasontype`, default the current season). Each extra is one more lookup; one that the league does not offer comes back as `{error}`.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: For include=leaders: season year (the year the season ends for NBA/NHL, e.g. 2025 = 2024-25). Default the current season.

parameters.name: seasontype
parameters.description: For include=leaders: 1 preseason, 2 regular season (default), 3 postseason, 4 off season.

parameters.name: leaders_limit
parameters.description: For include=leaders: players per category (1-20, default 5).

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
